**Major revision: Identity handling is now fully automatic, with improved modularity and new analysis modules.**

- Internal identity parameters (open-id) are completely managed by the system; users are never prompted for or shown identity info.
- All user flows, including report queries, now leverage automatic internal identity association.
- Refactored for clearer module boundaries; new `smyx_analysis` submodule and supporting files introduced.
- Removed legacy face analysis module to streamline skill focus.
- Documentation updated to reflect automated identity, stricter API/cloud query requirements, and a more concise user experience.
- Table outputs, analysis workflows, and rules governing report access are clarified and simplified for all users.

- Improved configuration management to support dev and test environments (updated config-dev.yaml, config-test.yaml).
- Enhanced shared utilities and initialization logic in smyx_common/scripts for better modularity and maintainability.
- Updated handling of API keys and open-id retrieval in configuration and utility scripts.
- Minor code refactoring in main and utility script files for improved clarity and consistency.

Fraud Call Identification Analysis Tool — Initial Release

- Provides real-time, multi-dimensional risk analysis of incoming call content to identify fraud and assess risk level.
- Supports analysis of audio files, audio URLs, or call transcripts, with automatic report generation.
- Enforces strict rules for open-id acquisition and mandates cloud-based report queries (local memory strictly forbidden).
- Includes clear instructions for use, open-id handling, and output formatting for both report and report list views (with Markdown table examples).
- Multi-language description and detailed process control for secure and compliant fraud call analysis workflows.
